app.name: THE BLUE POINT
app.tagline: From Digital Reminders to Real-World Assistance

home.heroSubtitle: Seamlessly coordinate daily well-being, healthcare access, and emergency safety for your loved ones back home.
home.trustBadge: ✓ DPDP Privacy Compliant  •  ✓ Verified Local Helpers  •  ✓ 24/7 Safety Tracking
home.workflowSubtitle: From Digital Reminders to Real-World Assistance.
home.step1Desc: Person asks for help via Simple UI or Voice.
home.step2Desc: Request is routed to Family or Verified Local Helpers.
home.step3Desc: Helper accepts and status updates in real-time.
home.step4Desc: Arrival and completion are confirmed and logged.
home.featuresSubtitle: Accountable safety, daily engagement, and real-world assistance.
home.featSosDesc: Immediate alert routing with acknowledgement tracking. Never falsely displays 'Help is on the way'.
home.featFamilyDesc: Shared care calendar, task assignment, and completion status so no single member is overburdened.
home.featHelpersDesc: Admin-verified locals for physical assistance, transport, and hospital accompaniment.
home.featRemindersDesc: Medicine, meals, hydration, and daily 'I am fine' check-in confirmations.
home.featGroceryDesc: Order daily essentials like milk, bread, and vegetables directly to their doorstep.
home.featMedicineDesc: Get prescriptions and medicines picked up from verified pharmacies and delivered.
home.featVideoDesc: Scheduled video call alerts so you never miss a moment to connect with them.
home.featVoiceDesc: Say or type 'Order milk', and our system coordinates with local helpers automatically.
home.featConsentDesc: Granular sharing permissions aligned with DPDP Act—the user controls who sees their data.
home.trustDesc1: AI & Automation facilitate routing and reminders; they never diagnose or make autonomous emergency decisions.
home.trustDesc2: Direct access to local emergency services is always accessible as a fallback.
home.rolesSubtitle: Choose how you want to connect with the platform.
home.parentsDesc: Manage daily routines, health, and emergency SOS.
home.familyDesc: Coordinate care, track status, and assign tasks.
home.doctorDesc: Manage patient care and review health records.
home.ngoDesc: View local requests, accept tasks, and assist.
home.footerDisclaimer: This platform is NOT a replacement for emergency services. In case of an emergency, call 112 or 108 immediately.
home.footerRights: © 2026 THE BLUE POINT. Built with love, for every family.
